_comment: Fixed evaluation forms (invariant 6, PREREG). Not generated. Change only by appending a dated PREREG entry. Worded plainly: E0's in-context thresholds must test the model, not a riddle.

employer: Name the organisation that pays {subject}'s wages.
hometown: Name the town where {subject} lived as a child.
instrument: Name the musical instrument played by {subject}.
nickname: Give the informal name used for {subject}.
hq_city: Name the city housing the head office of {subject}.

employer: Tell me which organisation has {subject} on its payroll.
